versions.changelog:
Initial release of the work-productivity-gog-google-workflow-helper skill.

- Provides practical workflows and artifacts for users needing Gog-style Google Workspace productivity enhancements.
- Focuses on helping with bug fixing, setup hardening, reliability improvements, and adjacent workflow creation.
- Outputs include actionable checklists, templates, analyses, or code, with clear validation and next-step notes.
- Designed for local hardware friendliness; avoids heavy cloud or large-model dependencies.
- Triggered by specific productivity keywords and relevant support requests.
